pa1.question: In this model, Marta before anyone presses the give-portal-access button: what is she?
pa1.notes: In this case, I would say Marta could be a user of the agency app or the main stakeholder user of the client portal app for whatever project or app a company is giving us to work on.

pa2.question: Unlimited nesting allows a loop: Bergman linked under Delaval AND Delaval linked under Bergman. Loops make roll-ups (savings per family tree) count things twice or run forever. What do we do?
pa2.selected: Block the exact link that closes a loop, with a plain message (recommended)

pa3.question: Which account rows get a short code (BERG) and reference sequences?
pa3.selected: Only accounts we actually do work for — staff assign a code when the relationship starts (recommended)

pa4.question: Can staff link one individual under a parent WITHOUT giving them portal access, and separately give portal access WITHOUT them being under any entity (a freelancer who is their own account)?
pa4.selected: Yes — both independent, exactly as described

dr1.question: Confirm the sign-in change: email OTP or Google, matched by email, invite-only unchanged?

dr2.question: Someone with delete permission deletes an account row that has 3 contacts, 40 tickets and 200 work logs hanging off it. What happens?

rg2.question: Vectorize has a terrible month and we want off it. What happens to our knowledge?
rg2.selected: Nothing is lost — chunks live in D1, we re-fingerprint onto a new index in minutes

gg1.question: Which emails from a connected staff Gmail get indexed into the knowledge layer?
gg1.selected: Only threads with people at our accounts — matched by the email addresses on account rows (recommended)

gg2.question: Google Chat — which conversations get indexed?

gg3.question: Google Meet — what gets ingested?

gg4.question: Who can SEE knowledge that came from a staffer's personal Gmail or Chat?

gg5.question: Can the agent act in Gmail on your behalf?

ag1.question: How much freedom does the agent get when acting on your behalf?
ag1.notes: I think the agent should have full autonomy, but it should have the same power and permissions as the user with their current member role has. The member role of the user trying to connect and talk with their agent has certain rights and does not have certain rights. The agent is gated by those same permissions. Also, for reading and adding rows, there should be no confirmation, but for any destructive actions like archiving, deleting, or any writing, adding, editing, updating, deleting, or archiving, there should be a confirmation.

ag2.question: Model strategy, given Claude cannot live on Workers AI:
ag2.selected: Anthropic via Cloudflare AI Gateway: Claude quality, Cloudflare dashboard + spend caps, Anthropic credits behind it (recommended)

ag3.question: The agent closes a to-do for you. Which door did it use?
